name: world-cup-scorelines
title: Men's World Cup match scorelines, 2010–2026
description: 360 matches from five tournaments, with separate regulation, cumulative extra-time and shoot-out scores.

fields.name: source_row
fields.description: One-based match position within the pinned tournament JSON file.

fields.name: match_date
fields.description: Calendar date recorded for the match by OpenFootball.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: Tournament stage, normalized across the five source files.

fields.name: group_name
fields.description: Group label from the source. Empty in knockout matches.

fields.name: team1
fields.description: First team in the original match record.

fields.name: team2
fields.description: Second team in the original match record.

fields.name: regulation1
fields.description: Team 1 goals at the end of regulation, including stoppage time.

fields.name: regulation2
fields.description: Team 2 goals at the end of regulation, including stoppage time.

fields.name: extra_time1
fields.description: Team 1 cumulative goals at the end of extra time, including regulation. Empty when that phase was not played.

fields.name: extra_time2
fields.description: Team 2 cumulative goals at the end of extra time, including regulation. Empty when that phase was not played.

fields.name: shootout1
fields.description: Team 1 converted kicks in the separate penalty shoot-out. Empty when that phase was not played.

fields.name: shootout2
fields.description: Team 2 converted kicks in the separate penalty shoot-out. Empty when that phase was not played.

fields.name: decision
fields.description: Phase that decided the match, or Draw for a tied group match.

fields.name: winner
fields.description: Winning team across the phases played. Empty for a group-stage draw.
